verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents typed official SDKs for ten languages, including JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart and .NET. It also has dedicated official JavaScript (full TypeScript) and Python (async, type hints) clients, plus a first-party Laravel Scout driver. One community report says the Rails gems fell out of step with server releases and were temporarily incompatible, which is a real maintenance caveat but does not contradict that the SDKs exist. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation in the evidence for most languages, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and evidence that SDK versions stay in sync with server releases.
